name: Sybill
description: Sybill is the context layer for your revenue org. Connect it to Claude and ask anything about your sales conversations, deals, and pipeline grounded in real call transcripts, AI-generated summaries, MEDDIC scores, and CRM data. Surface action items from calls, identify at-risk deals, prep for meetings with full conversation history, and spot patterns across your team's interactions. Sybill unifies the fragmented signals across calls, emails, and CRM into a single coherent picture that Claude can reason over.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sybill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sybill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sybill.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sybill MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sybill provides these MCP tools: ask_sybill, list_conversations, get_conversation, list_deals, and get_deal.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sybill?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sybill in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Sybill requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sybill is developed by Sybill Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
